idea-plugin.name: IssueManager
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the GitHub issues of the open repository as a list in Rider and connects them with branches and worktrees.

  • Issue list in a tool window, with search, sorting and filters, grouped by milestone, type, label or assignee
  • Description and comments of an issue as a tab in the editor, including images
  • Write a comment, assign an issue to yourself or remove your assignment
  • Change type and labels of an issue, also by dragging it onto a group
  • Open an issue in a new, the current or an existing branch, and switch to its branch
  • Start an issue with a command in the terminal, for example a coding agent that gets the issue as its prompt
  • Open Rider's "New Worktree" dialog for an issue, and jump to the window of a worktree
  • Texts in English and German, following the language of the operating system

Getting started: configure a GitHub account in Rider (Settings | Version Control | GitHub) and open a project whose origin remote points to github.com. The issues appear in the "Issues" tool window. The plugin uses the account from Rider and needs no token of its own.

Source code and documentation: github.com/MToffano/de.toffano.issuemanager
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.2

  • A changed type or label shows in the list right away, before GitHub confirms it
  • Changes go to GitHub one after the other, in the order they were made. The list is loaded again once all are done, and failed changes are listed in the status line

0.5.1

  • The menus "Change type" and "Labels" close after a click

0.5.0

  • Change the type of an issue, choosing from the types of the repository
  • Add or remove labels of an issue, choosing from the labels of the repository
  • Drag an issue onto another group to change its type or add a label, when grouped by type or label
  • Rider shows these notes before installing an update

0.4.2

  • "Open in current branch" is now called "Link to current branch": it links the checked-out branch to the issue and checks nothing out

0.4.1

  • Updates through a custom plugin repository: add the address from the README under Settings | Plugins | Manage Plugin Repositories, and Rider offers new versions by itself

0.4.0

  • Start an issue with a command in a new terminal tab, for example a coding agent that gets the issue as its prompt. Commands and prompt templates are set up under Settings | Tools | IssueManager
  • A command can check out the branch of the issue first, or offer the names for a new branch
  • Copy the prompt for an issue to the clipboard
  • Group the list by milestone, type, label or assignee
  • Hide issues by type or label
  • The issue type is shown in the content of an issue

0.3.1

  • The plugin is offered for Rider only
  • Vendor contact details and a longer description
